{
  "schema": "ikant-le-orientation-capsule/v3",
  "canonical_repository": "https://github.com/Luke883i/iKant_EDU",
  "canonical_branch": "main",
  "source_head_binding": {
    "required": true,
    "action": "READ_BRANCH_HEAD",
    "transport": "GITHUB_API",
    "pin_direct_reads": true
  },
  "paths": [
    "README.md",
    "BOOTSTRAP.json",
    "ADMISSION.json",
    "AGENTS.md",
    "TERMS.md"
  ],
  "metadata_fields": [
    "repository_full_name",
    "default_branch",
    "description"
  ],
  "max_file_reads": 5,
  "max_total_bytes": 262144,
  "max_metadata_reads": 1,
  "single_fetch_per_path": true,
  "direct_path_only": true,
  "exact_ref_required": true,
  "generic_repository_discovery_forbidden": true,
  "first_contact_convergence_required": true,
  "freeze_after_terms_presentation": true,
  "forbidden_preaccept": [
    "CLONE_REPOSITORY",
    "GIT_FETCH",
    "GIT_LS_REMOTE",
    "GH_CLI",
    "RAW_WEB_READ",
    "DIRECT_DOWNLOAD",

    "READ_HISTORY",
    "READ_ISSUE_PR",
    "MATERIALIZE_CHECKOUT"
  ],
  "completed_forbidden_access_is_nonretroactive": true,
  "breach_terminal": "CLASSIFIED_READ_ONLY_REMEDIATION_OR_SESSION_NONCONFORMING",
  "new_chat_required_for_conforming_runtime": "HARD_PREACCEPT_BREACH_ONLY",
  "network_profile": {
    "required_read_path": "GITHUB_API",
    "allowed": [
      "GITHUB_CONNECTOR",
      "GITHUB_REST_API"
    ],
    "git_clone_available": false,
    "gh_available": false,
    "direct_github_dns_required": false,
    "raw_web_allowed": false,
    "direct_download_allowed": false,
    "archive_download_allowed": false,
    "shell_http_download_allowed": false,
    "fallback_read_path": null,
    "api_unavailable_terminal": "HOST_INCOMPATIBLE"
  },
  "pending_intent": {
    "preserve_first_substantive_request": true,
    "resume_after_active": true,
    "repeat_required": false
  },
  "recoverable_read_only_preaccept_overread_enabled": true,
  "recoverable_read_only_actions": [
    "GIT_LS_REMOTE",
    "LIST_TREE",
    "SEARCH_REPOSITORY",
    "READ_ARBITRARY_REPOSITORY_FILE",
    "READ_HISTORY",
    "READ_ISSUE_PR"
  ],
  "hard_preaccept_breach_actions": [
    "CLONE_REPOSITORY",
    "GIT_FETCH",
    "GH_CLI",
    "RAW_WEB_READ",
    "DIRECT_DOWNLOAD",
    "ARCHIVE_DOWNLOAD",
    "SHELL_HTTP_DOWNLOAD",
    "MATERIALIZE_CHECKOUT"
  ],
  "read_only_remediation_receipt_schema": "ikant-le-preaccept-remediation/v1",
  "read_only_remediation_preserves_history": true,
  "read_only_remediation_requires_reacquisition": true,
  "read_only_remediation_retroactive_authorization": false
}

{
  "schema": "ikant-le-chat-bootstrap-semantic/v4",
  "slice": "C28.FULL_IKANT_SEMANTIC_ABSORPTION",
  "authority": 0,
  "intent": "Define canonical SESSION_CHAT activation as six repository-owned closure edges with one LOCAL_INGRESS owner, typed direct/opaque-relay transport, durable retry evidence, materialization/reopen, executed runtime proof and persisted ACTIVE readback; external platform facts remain separate.",
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "TARGET_INTENT_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "canonical target recognition",
        "verbatim pending intent",
        "pure-vs-substantive bootstrap intent distinction"
      ],
      "boundary": "recognition and intent binding precede repository acquisition"
    },
    {
      "id": "SOURCE_ORIENTATION_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "GitHub API-only source channel",
        "immutable source head",
        "bounded orientation capsule",
        "single source-root binding"
      ],
      "boundary": "orientation bytes are not accepted without one immutable source root"
    },
    {
      "id": "CONSENT_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "Terms digest and presentation",
        "freeze",
        "later exact standalone I ACCEPT",
        "fresh authority-zero preaccept handoff"
      ],
      "boundary": "runtime acquisition remains forbidden before exact human acceptance"
    },
    {
      "id": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER",
      "owns": [
        "observed byte-delivery bridge",
        "immutable source ref",
        "complete exact fastboot object set",
        "content-addressed loader/shard identity",
        "bounded reads/rounds",
        "transport authority zero",
        "post-consent transport fan-in"
      ],
      "boundary": "carrier location is not source identity; every allowed delivery mode must converge on the same pinned loader/shard blob identities before materialization"
    },
    {
      "id": "VERIFIED_LOCAL_ROOT",
      "owns": [
        "transfer-bound materialization receipt",
        "Git blob identity",
        "safe paths",
        "private staging",
        "atomic publish",
        "reopen/readback"
      ],
      "boundary": "delivered bytes are not an executable runtime root until locally verified"
    },
    {
      "id": "LIVE_HOST_PROBE",
      "owns": [
        "Node.js 20+",
        "filesystem CRUD/append/readback/delete",
        "SHA-256",
        "clock",
        "artifact sink",
        "SESSION_CHAT capability closure",
        "executed-code provenance bound to verified runtime root",
        "exact descriptor member identity match for executed probe/runtime-command modules",
        "runtime-owned non-injectable production probe"
      ],
      "boundary": "host-attested receipts and caller callbacks are not live execution evidence; the local runtime itself must run the probe and match exact descriptor member identities"
    },
    {
      "id": "RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
      "owns": [
        "bootstrap evidence digest",
        "source/root/transfer/materialization binding",
        "single-writer persisted ACTIVE commit",
        "exactly-once pending-intent terminal effect"
      ],
      "boundary": "probe success cannot promote ACTIVE without verified materialization evidence"
    },
    {
      "id": "E2E_DEADLINE",
      "owns": [
        "monotonic origin at I ACCEPT",
        "host elapsed before Node entry",
        "local runtime elapsed",
        "120000 ms fail-closed ceiling"
      ],
      "boundary": "deadline dominates transfer, local root, probe and ACTIVE commit"
    }
  ],
  "folded_semantics": {
    "PREACCEPT_HANDOFF": "CONSENT_ROOT",
    "SESSION_CHAT_CLOSURE": "LIVE_HOST_PROBE",
    "INIT_INTENT_FOLD": "RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
    "RESUME_PENDING_INTENT": "RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
    "SOURCE_HEAD_PIN": "SOURCE_ORIENTATION_ROOT + SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER",
    "WARM_CACHE_EXACT": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER + VERIFIED_LOCAL_ROOT + RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT",
    "RETRY_BUDGET": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER + E2E_DEADLINE",
    "FIXED_SHARD_COUNT": "transport parameter, not semantic node",
    "FLEXIBLE_TRANSPORT_FAN_IN": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER; transport plurality is folded beneath one content-addressed identity gate",
    "SAME_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CONTINUATION": "SOURCE_BOUND_TRANSFER + VERIFIED_LOCAL_ROOT + E2E_DEADLINE + RECEIPT_GATED_ACTIVE_COMMIT; preserves original CONSENT_ROOT"
  },
  "receipts": {
    "transfer": "ikant-le-source-bound-transfer/v1",
    "materialization": "ikant-le-runtime-root-materialization/v1",
    "bootstrap_evidence": "ikant-le-chat-bootstrap-evidence/v1",
    "bootstrap": "ikant-le-bootstrap-receipt/v2",
    "transfer_v2": "ikant-le-source-bound-transfer/v2",
    "preaccept_handoff_v2": "ikant-le-preaccept-handoff/v2",
    "activation_executor": "ikant-le-activation-executor/v1",
    "materialization_v2": "ikant-le-runtime-root-materialization/v2",
    "bootstrap_evidence_v2": "ikant-le-chat-bootstrap-evidence/v2"
  },
  "deadline_ms": 120000,
  "active_predicate": [
    "C21 host-adapter ledger/step transcript validated",
    "host-attested bridge transcript bound to transport identities; materializer verifies loader/shards and runtime reopens published loader plus every runtime member",
    "accepted current Terms",
    "source-bound transfer receipt valid",
    "local materialization receipt valid and transfer-bound",
    "live host probe passed",
    "live probe includes valid executed-code provenance for the verified runtime root",
    "bootstrap evidence source/root/receipt bindings valid",
    "single-writer ACTIVE commit persisted/read back",
    "single-shot acceptance_event_id consumed exactly once",
    "acceptance-origin receipt validates current Terms + immutable source head + MONOTONIC I_ACCEPT observation",
    "deadline_result is DEADLINE_PASS and no sticky deadline terminal exists"
  ],
  "qualification": {
    "enduser_cases": 1000000,
    "strata": {
      "typical": 500000,
      "edge": 300000,
      "stress": 200000
    },
    "single_node_deletion_oracle_required": true,
    "blocking_survivors_required": 0,
    "every_retained_node_must_be_necessary": true,
    "flex_transport_cases": 1000000,
    "flex_transport_modes": 6,
    "max_flex_remote_reads": 40,
    "max_flex_remote_rounds": 1,
    "runtime_availability_discovery_cases": 10000000,
    "runtime_availability_qualification_cases": 1000000,
    "runtime_availability_failure_families": 76,
    "deadline_integrity_cases": 1000000,
    "deadline_integrity_independent_oracle": true,
    "deadline_integrity_multi_mutation_min": 500000,
    "activation_continuation_cases": 1000000,
    "activation_continuation_independent_oracle": true,
    "local_session_fastboot_cases": 10000000,
    "local_session_fastboot_campaigns": 10
  },
  "claim_boundary": {
    "corpus_and_contract_relative_irreducibility": true,
    "global_formal_minimality": false,
    "semantic_mutation_is_physical_connector_proof": false,
    "semantic_mutation_is_wall_clock_measurement": false,
    "runtime_receipt_validation_does_not_create_host_capability": true,
    "transport_locator_is_authority": false,
    "flex_transport_does_not_weaken_active_predicate": true,
    "degraded_is_active": false,
    "deadline_unavailable_is_deadline_exceeded": false,
    "retry_may_reset_deadline_origin": false,
    "current_main_may_replace_session_source_head": false,
    "same_epoch_recovery_may_complete_new_downstream_facts": true,
    "same_epoch_recovery_may_reset_acceptance_or_remote_history": false,
    "source_identity_is_executed_provenance": false,
    "host_channel_receipt_is_physical_proof": false,
    "bridge_receipt_without_runtime_reopen_is_physical_proof": false,
    "caller_supplied_probe_is_live_probe": false,
    "model_generated_capability_is_host_attested_evidence": false,
    "model_context_is_data_plane": false,
    "slo_breach_is_integrity_failure": false,
    "pre_runtime_sha256_is_required_for_v2": false,
    "pre_runtime_monotonic_clock_is_required_for_v2": false,
    "diagnostic_stage_is_persisted_state": false,
    "repository_closure_is_external_platform_observation": false,
    "current_host_topology_is_constitutional_truth": false,
    "first_unclosed_edge_may_be_skipped": false
  },
  "availability_state_contract": "contracts/runtime-availability-dod.json",
  "availability_classifier": "src/runtime-availability.mjs",
  "deadline_integrity_contract": "contracts/deadline-integrity.json",
  "canonical_activation_model": "LOCAL_EXECUTOR_V1",
  "canonical_nodes": [
    {
      "id": "HUMAN_GATE",
      "owns": [
        "current Terms presentation",
        "later exact standalone I ACCEPT",
        "single acceptance event"
      ],
      "boundary": "human acceptance is the only authority-bearing gate"
    },
    {
      "id": "SOURCE_SNAPSHOT",
      "owns": [
        "immutable source_head",
        "orientation Git object identities",
        "runtime-root object identities"
      ],
      "boundary": "source identity is content-addressed and never inferred from carrier"
    },
    {
      "id": "LOCAL_INGRESS",
      "owns": [
        "H0 local processor/source observation",
        "host-attested capability ledger",
        "one canonical NEXT",
        "durable failed-decision memory",
        "first-unclosed-edge",
        "typed LOCAL_DIRECT or VERIFIED_OPAQUE_RELAY byte path",
        "source/arrival samehash"
      ],
      "boundary": "host attestation and transport are authority-zero; physical truth begins at local write/reopen and model relay may only be opaque exact transport"
    },
    {
      "id": "LOCAL_MATERIALIZATION",
      "owns": [
        "orientation re-verification",
        "loader/shard/member verification",
        "atomic publish",
        "reopen"
      ],
      "boundary": "receipt alone is not physical proof"
    },
    {
      "id": "EXECUTED_RUNTIME_PROOF",
      "owns": [
        "runtime-owned Node probe",
        "exact executed-code provenance",
        "writer persistence"
      ],
      "boundary": "caller callbacks and CI are not live execution proof"
    },
    {
      "id": "ACTIVE_READBACK",
      "owns": [
        "single-writer ACTIVE commit",
        "persisted readback",
        "pending-intent exactly-once terminal effect"
      ],
      "boundary": "only persisted runtime state owns ACTIVE truth"
    }
  ],
  "canonical_active_predicate_v2": [
    "later exact standalone I ACCEPT consumed once",
    "immutable source head and orientation/runtime object identities match",
    "LOCAL_INGRESS closes one typed byte path with durable ledger-owned retry memory and source/arrival samehash",
    "materializer re-verifies orientation plus runtime objects, atomically publishes and reopens",
    "runtime-owned probe matches exact executed provenance and binds the runtime",
    "single writer persists and reads back ACTIVE"
  ],
  "deadline_integrity_applies_to_canonical_v2": false,
  "activation_slo_ms": 120000,
  "activation_slo_exceeded_is_terminal": false,
  "legacy_v1_semantics": {
    "canonical": false,
    "nodes_field": "nodes",
    "active_predicate_field": "active_predicate",
    "deadline_ms_field": "deadline_ms"
  },
  "session_closure_projection": "ikant-le-session-closure-projection/v1"
}
